mapper.sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(S.SYSMANA_NO) AS SYSMANA_NO, S.TRAIN_DIFF_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(S.TRAIN_DIFF_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRAIN_DIFF_CODE_NAME, S.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(S.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRAIN_TYPE_CODE_NAME, S.TRAIN_TYPE_NO, S.REMARK FROM EDU_SYSTEM_MANAGER S
mapper.select: WHERE S.SYSMANA_NO = #{sysmanaNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND S.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EDU_SYSTEM_MANAGER (SYSMANA_NO, TRAIN_DIFF_CODE, TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, TRAIN_TYPE_NO, REMARK, ACTIVITY, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_IP, CPNY_ID) VALUES (EDU_SYS_MANA_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{trainDiffCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trainTypeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trainTypeNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '1', SYSDATE, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
